list.name: stage_owner
list.label: Stage owner
list.description: Team that owns the stage an idle GPU waits in. All = no filter (also keeps rows with no owner).
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT stage_owner FROM capacity_intervals WHERE stage_owner IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT stage_owner FROM capacity_intervals WHERE stage_owner IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.description: Site from assets.site; assets with no site appear as '(none)'. All = no site filter.
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(site, '(none)') FROM assets ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(site, '(none)') FROM assets ORDER BY 1

list.name: snapshot
list.label: Price snapshot (USD)
list.description: AWS On-Demand pricing snapshot for present-day value. Default: the engine's selection (TTV_PRICING_SNAPSHOT, else the latest published). Historical value always uses, per interval, the snapshot in force when the interval started.
list.query:
SELECT s.snapshot_id FROM pricing_snapshots s
LEFT JOIN pricing_selection sel ON sel.snapshot_id = s.snapshot_id
ORDER BY (sel.snapshot_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, s.publication_date DESC NULLS LAST, s.captured_at DESC
list.definition:
SELECT s.snapshot_id FROM pricing_snapshots s
LEFT JOIN pricing_selection sel ON sel.snapshot_id = s.snapshot_id
ORDER BY (sel.snapshot_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, s.publication_date DESC NULLS LAST, s.captured_at DESC

panels.title: Idle GPUs
panels.description:
Definition: GPUs in open IDLE intervals (the latest engine scan), all stage owners together; the queue table splits them by owner.
Filters: site, stage_owner.
Unknown vs zero: UNKNOWN GPUs are never counted here; 'no GPUs in scope' before the first scan or when the site filter matches no GPU.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 JOIN assets a0 ON a0.asset_id = i0.asset_id WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a0.site, '(none)') IN ($site))) THEN coalesce((
  SELECT sum(i.gpus)
  FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE' AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site)) AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))), 0) END AS "Idle GPUs"

panels.title: Overdue now
panels.description:
Definition: idle GPUs whose current stage episode has lasted longer than the stage objective of the interval's own policy version. Intervals with no objective are not counted (Selected period shows them).
Filters: site, stage_owner.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 JOIN assets a0 ON a0.asset_id = i0.asset_id WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a0.site, '(none)') IN ($site))) THEN coalesce((
  SELECT sum(i.gpus)
  FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  JOIN stage_objectives o ON o.stage = i.stage AND o.policy_version = i.policy_version
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE' AND now() > i.stage_entered_at + o.objective
    AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site)) AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))), 0) END AS "Overdue GPUs"

panels.title: Longest wait
panels.description:
Definition: the longest current idle stage episode, in days since stage_entered_at. 'at least' = that stage began before observation, so the true wait is longer.
Filters: site, stage_owner.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - i.stage_entered_at) / 86400 AS days,
       CASE WHEN i.stage_entered_lower_bound THEN 'at least' ELSE 'observed' END AS label
FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.stage_entered_at IS NOT NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site)) AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
ORDER BY i.stage_entered_at
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Idle value / hour (AWS)
panels.description:
Definition: what the idle GPUs now would cost per hour at AWS On-Demand rates (Linux, shared tenancy) from the selected price snapshot, shown under the value. A comparison, not a bill, not our cost and not a loss (ADR-0003).
'at least' means some idle GPUs have no price (their model has no rate) and are left out; Queues lists them. The line above the value names the snapshot's region and price date.
Filters: site, stage_owner, snapshot.

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT coalesce(sum(i.gpus), 0) AS gpus,
         sum(i.gpus * r.per_gpu_hour_usd) AS usd,
         coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE r.per_gpu_hour_usd IS NULL), 0) AS unpriced
  FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
LEFT JOIN pricing_rates r ON r.snapshot_id = '${snapshot}' AND r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE' AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site)) AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
), s AS (
  SELECT region || ', ' || to_char(publication_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS label
  FROM pricing_snapshots WHERE snapshot_id = '${snapshot}'
)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 JOIN assets a0 ON a0.asset_id = i0.asset_id WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a0.site, '(none)') IN ($site))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s) THEN coalesce(v.usd, CASE WHEN v.gpus = 0 THEN 0 END) END AS usd,
       coalesce((SELECT label FROM s), 'no price snapshot')
       || CASE WHEN v.unpriced > 0 THEN ' · at least (' || v.unpriced || ' GPUs unpriced)' ELSE '' END AS label
FROM v

panels.title: Unknown GPUs
panels.description:
Definition: GPUs in open UNKNOWN intervals. They are in no queue: the evidence is missing (stale source, identity conflict, cluster not observed, node not found). Evidence explains each reason.
Filters: site.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 JOIN assets a0 ON a0.asset_id = i0.asset_id WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a0.site, '(none)') IN ($site))) THEN coalesce((
  SELECT sum(i.gpus) FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'UNKNOWN' AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))), 0) END AS "Unknown GPUs"

panels.title: Data age
panels.description:
Definition: time since the newest engine scan that finished ok or partial. Every 'now' number on this page is as of that scan. Green within 15 min (3 scans), orange within 1 h, red beyond.
Filters: none.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - max(finished_at)) AS "Data age"
FROM scan_runs
WHERE status IN ('ok', 'partial') AND finished_at IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Stage queues now (pipeline order)
panels.description:
Definition: the four handoff queues in pipeline order. Per stage owner: idle GPUs now; overdue GPUs (idle past the stage objective of the interval's own policy version); servers waiting; the oldest and median wait among their current stage episodes; idle GPUs with no price at the snapshot; the objective; the idle value per hour at the selected snapshot; and the reason holding the most GPUs.
'≥' marks waits that began before observation (minimums). Value '≥' means some GPUs are unpriced.
Filters: site (all four owners always show; stage_owner does not apply).

targets.rawSql:
WITH owners(owner, ord) AS (VALUES ('DC', 1), ('Redbull', 2), ('POPAI', 3), ('Serving', 4)),
iv AS (
  SELECT i.stage_owner, i.asset_id, i.stage_entered_at, i.stage_entered_lower_bound AS lb, i.gpus, i.reason_code,
         o.objective, r.per_gpu_hour_usd AS rate
  FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  LEFT JOIN stage_objectives o ON o.stage = i.stage AND o.policy_version = i.policy_version
  LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
LEFT JOIN pricing_rates r ON r.snapshot_id = '${snapshot}' AND r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE' AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
), ep AS (
  SELECT stage_owner, asset_id, stage_entered_at, bool_or(lb) AS lb
  FROM iv GROUP BY stage_owner, asset_id, stage_entered_at
), agg AS (
  SELECT stage_owner,
         sum(gpus) AS gpus,
         coalesce(sum(gpus) FILTER (WHERE objective IS NOT NULL AND now() > stage_entered_at + objective), 0) AS overdue,
         max(extract(epoch FROM objective)) / 86400 AS objective_d,
         sum(gpus * rate) AS usd,
         coalesce(sum(gpus) FILTER (WHERE rate IS NULL), 0) AS unpriced
  FROM iv GROUP BY stage_owner
), waits AS (
  SELECT stage_owner, count(*) AS servers, bool_or(lb) AS lb,
         max(extract(epoch FROM now() - stage_entered_at)) / 86400 AS oldest_d,
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM now() - stage_entered_at)) / 86400 AS median_d
  FROM ep GROUP BY stage_owner
), top_reason AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (stage_owner) stage_owner, reason_code
  FROM (SELECT stage_owner, reason_code, sum(gpus) AS g FROM iv GROUP BY 1, 2) x
  ORDER BY stage_owner, g DESC, reason_code
)
SELECT ow.owner AS "Stage owner",
       CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 JOIN assets a0 ON a0.asset_id = i0.asset_id WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a0.site, '(none)') IN ($site))) THEN coalesce(g.gpus, 0) END AS "Idle GPUs",
       CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i0 JOIN assets a0 ON a0.asset_id = i0.asset_id WHERE i0.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a0.site, '(none)') IN ($site))) THEN coalesce(g.overdue, 0) END AS "Overdue GPUs",
       w.servers AS "Servers",
       CASE WHEN w.lb THEN '≥ ' ELSE '' END || to_char(w.oldest_d, 'FM99990.0') || ' d' AS "Oldest wait",
       CASE WHEN w.lb THEN '≥ ' ELSE '' END || to_char(w.median_d, 'FM99990.0') || ' d' AS "Median wait",
       to_char(g.objective_d, 'FM9990.##') || ' d' AS "Objective",
       CASE WHEN g.gpus IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN g.usd IS NULL THEN 'unpriced'
            ELSE CASE WHEN g.unpriced > 0 THEN '≥ ' ELSE '' END || '$' || to_char(g.usd, 'FM999,999,990') END AS "Idle value / h",
       CASE WHEN g.gpus IS NOT NULL THEN g.unpriced END AS "Unpriced GPUs",
       t.reason_code AS "Main reason"
FROM owners ow
LEFT JOIN agg g ON g.stage_owner = ow.owner
LEFT JOIN waits w ON w.stage_owner = ow.owner
LEFT JOIN top_reason t ON t.stage_owner = ow.owner
ORDER BY ow.ord

panels.title: How long idle GPUs have waited, by stage owner
panels.description:
Definition: idle GPUs now, by stage owner (pipeline order) and by how long their current stage episode has lasted (now − stage_entered_at). Waits that began before observation are counted at their observed length, so the true distribution is further right.
Filters: site, stage_owner.

targets.rawSql:
WITH owners(owner, ord) AS (VALUES ('DC', 1), ('Redbull', 2), ('POPAI', 3), ('Serving', 4)),
iv AS (
  SELECT i.stage_owner, i.gpus, extract(epoch FROM now() - i.stage_entered_at) / 86400 AS d
  FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE' AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site)) AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
)
SELECT ow.owner AS "Stage owner",
       coalesce(sum(iv.gpus) FILTER (WHERE iv.d < 1), 0) AS "< 1 d",
       coalesce(sum(iv.gpus) FILTER (WHERE iv.d >= 1 AND iv.d < 3), 0) AS "1–3 d",
       coalesce(sum(iv.gpus) FILTER (WHERE iv.d >= 3 AND iv.d < 7), 0) AS "3–7 d",
       coalesce(sum(iv.gpus) FILTER (WHERE iv.d >= 7 AND iv.d < 30), 0) AS "7–30 d",
       coalesce(sum(iv.gpus) FILTER (WHERE iv.d >= 30), 0) AS "≥ 30 d"
FROM owners ow
LEFT JOIN iv ON iv.stage_owner = ow.owner
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scan_runs WHERE status IN ('ok', 'partial') AND finished_at IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY ow.owner, ow.ord
ORDER BY ow.ord

panels.title: Why: GPUs by category and reason now
panels.description:
Definition: sum(gpus) and distinct assets of open intervals, grouped by category, reason_code and stage owner. Categories are mutually exclusive per GPU, so GPUs add up to 'GPUs in scope' (with the same filters).
Units: physical GPUs; share = GPUs / all GPUs in the table.
Filters: site, stage_owner (selecting an owner keeps only that owner's IDLE rows; rows with no owner show only under All).
Unknown vs zero: UNKNOWN rows are GPUs we cannot classify, kept visible and never folded into IDLE or PRODUCTIVE. A reason absent from the table has 0 GPUs in the latest scan. Current state = intervals still open in the ledger (ended_at IS NULL), i.e. the result of the latest engine scan; check 'Data as of' for its age.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT i.category AS "Category",
       i.reason_code AS "Reason",
       coalesce(i.stage_owner, '—') AS "Stage owner",
       sum(i.gpus) AS "GPUs",
       count(DISTINCT i.asset_id) AS "Assets",
       sum(i.gpus)::float / sum(sum(i.gpus)) OVER () AS "Share of GPUs"
FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL
  AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
  AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
GROUP BY i.category, i.reason_code, i.stage_owner
ORDER BY CASE i.category WHEN 'IDLE' THEN 1 WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 2 WHEN 'PRODUCTIVE' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
         sum(i.gpus) DESC, i.reason_code

panels.title: Longest waits (current idle stage episodes)
panels.description:
Definition: one row per asset and current stage episode with open IDLE intervals; 'Idle GPUs' sums the asset's idle buckets in that stage now, 'Reason' lists their reason codes. 'In stage since' is stage_entered_at; 'Idle GPU-h in stage' sums every IDLE interval of the same episode (same asset, stage and stage_entered_at) from its start to now, not limited to the time range. Sorted by days in stage, longest first; top 50.
Units: GPUs, days, GPU-h. Times in UTC.
Filters: site, stage_owner.
Unknown vs zero: '≥' marks a stage that began before observation (stage_entered_lower_bound), so since, days and GPU-h are minimums. Next-action owner/reason come from the newest unexpired next_action_annotations row and are display only: they never change the stage owner or any total; empty = no annotation, not 'no action needed'. Current state = intervals still open in the ledger (ended_at IS NULL), i.e. the result of the latest engine scan; check 'Data as of' for its age. 'Cluster' is the target cluster once the node is known; 'Held by' names the workload holding idle GPUs (namespace/Kind/name) for the GPU-level rows, empty when nothing holds them.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT i.asset_id, i.stage, i.stage_owner, i.stage_entered_at,
         i.stage_entered_lower_bound AS lb,
         sum(i.gpus) AS gpus,
         string_agg(DISTINCT i.reason_code, ', ') AS reasons,
         string_agg(DISTINCT i.gpu_model, ', ') AS gpu_models,
         string_agg(DISTINCT i.cluster, ', ') AS clusters,
         string_agg(DISTINCT i.holder_ref, ', ') AS holders
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE'
    AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
    AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
  GROUP BY i.asset_id, i.stage, i.stage_owner, i.stage_entered_at, i.stage_entered_lower_bound
), ep AS (
  SELECT c.asset_id, c.stage, c.stage_entered_at,
         sum(j.gpus * extract(epoch FROM coalesce(j.ended_at, now()) - j.started_at)) / 3600 AS gpu_h
  FROM cur c
  JOIN capacity_intervals j
    ON j.asset_id = c.asset_id
   AND j.category = 'IDLE'
   AND j.stage IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.stage
   AND j.stage_entered_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.stage_entered_at
  GROUP BY c.asset_id, c.stage, c.stage_entered_at
)
SELECT c.asset_id AS "Asset",
       a.name AS "Name",
       coalesce(c.gpu_models, a.gpu_model) AS "GPU model",
       c.gpus AS "Idle GPUs",
       c.stage_owner AS "Stage owner",
       c.reasons AS "Reason",
       c.clusters AS "Cluster",
       c.holders AS "Held by",
       coalesce(CASE WHEN c.lb THEN '≥ ' ELSE '' END
                || to_char(c.stage_entered_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), 'unknown') AS "In stage since (UTC)",
       coalesce(CASE WHEN c.lb THEN '≥ ' ELSE '' END
                || to_char(extract(epoch FROM now() - c.stage_entered_at) / 86400, 'FM999990.0'), 'unknown') AS "Days in stage",
       coalesce(CASE WHEN c.lb THEN '≥ ' ELSE '' END
                || to_char(ep.gpu_h, 'FM9999999990.0'), 'unknown') AS "Idle GPU-h in stage",
       na.next_action_owner AS "Next-action owner"
FROM cur c
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = c.asset_id
LEFT JOIN ep ON ep.asset_id = c.asset_id
            AND ep.stage IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.stage
            AND ep.stage_entered_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.stage_entered_at
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT n.next_action_owner, n.reason
  FROM next_action_annotations n
  WHERE n.asset_id = c.asset_id AND n.expires_at > now()
  ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
) na ON true
ORDER BY now() - c.stage_entered_at DESC NULLS FIRST, c.gpus DESC, c.asset_id
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Now: AWS-equivalent value (On-Demand comparison, not a bill or a loss)
Unpriced idle GPUs now
panels.description:
Definition: GPUs idle now whose model has no rate in the selected snapshot ($snapshot): not in the GPU catalogue (e.g. a raw model server-scan could not identify), no defensible AWS equivalent (e.g. AMD Instinct, A16), or missing from the snapshot. The engine also exports ttv_unpriced_gpus{gpu_model} for every observed GPU.
Units: physical GPUs.
Filters: site, stage_owner, snapshot.
Unknown vs zero: these GPUs are idle and charged in GPU-hours, but have no USD value; they are never valued at $0. No data = no idle GPUs in scope.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE r.per_gpu_hour_usd IS NULL), 0) END AS gpus
FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
LEFT JOIN pricing_rates r ON r.snapshot_id = '${snapshot}' AND r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE'
  AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
  AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))

panels.title: Unpriced idle GPUs now, by model
panels.description:
Definition: the GPUs counted in 'Unpriced idle GPUs now', by the model string the inventory reported, its canonical catalogue name and why it has no rate in $snapshot (the reason comes from config/pricing/gpu-instance-map.yaml).
Units: physical GPUs.
Filters: site, stage_owner, snapshot.
Unknown vs zero: an empty table means every idle GPU in scope is priced.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(i.gpu_model, '(no model reported)') AS "GPU model (as reported)",
       coalesce(ga.canonical, '—') AS "Canonical model",
       sum(i.gpus) AS "Idle GPUs",
       CASE WHEN i.gpu_model IS NULL THEN 'no GPU model reported'
            WHEN ga.raw_model IS NULL THEN 'not yet canonicalised by the engine'
            WHEN ga.canonical IS NULL THEN 'not in the GPU catalogue'
            WHEN r.gpu_model IS NULL THEN 'no rate in the selected snapshot'
            ELSE coalesce(r.reason, 'unpriced') END AS "Why unpriced"
FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
LEFT JOIN pricing_rates r ON r.snapshot_id = '${snapshot}' AND r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE'
  AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
  AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
  AND r.per_gpu_hour_usd IS NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2, 4
ORDER BY 3 DESC, 1

defaults.noValue: Every idle GPU in scope is priced

panels.title: Selected period: idle and overdue time and value
Idle and overdue GPU-hours in the time range, by stage owner
panels.description:
Definition: for every IDLE interval, clipped to the dashboard time range (open intervals end at now()):
- Idle GPU-h = gpus x hours idle in range.
- Overdue GPU-h = gpus x hours in range after stage_entered_at + objective, where objective comes from stage_objectives joined on (stage, policy_version) of the interval. Raw idle and overdue are separate (AGENT.md §17: 8 GPUs idle 3 h = 24 idle GPU-h; with a 1 h objective only 16 are overdue).
Units: GPU-h (GPU-hours).
Filters: site, stage_owner, time range.
Unknown vs zero: 'Stage clock' shows '≥' when some stage started before observation (stage_entered_lower_bound): overdue is then a minimum. Idle time with no objective for its (stage, policy_version) is in 'Idle GPU-h, no objective' and is not counted as 0 overdue. Time before an asset was first observed is unknown and not counted. Owners with 0 had no idle GPU-hours in the range.
Value (USD): 'Idle value' and 'Overdue value' = GPU-hours x the per-GPU rate of each GPU's model in the selected present-day snapshot ($snapshot), joined raw model -> gpu_model_aliases -> pricing_rates. Empty = nothing in that row could be priced (or overdue is not computable). 'Unpriced idle GPU-h' are idle GPU-hours with no rate; they are never valued at $0. AWS-equivalent value is a comparison: what the same GPU-hours would cost at AWS On-Demand (Linux, shared tenancy, us-east-1). It is not a bill, not our cost and not a proven loss (AGENT.md §10). Per-GPU rate = whole instance price / physical GPUs, so it includes the host's share and is not a GPU-only tariff; similar GPU names do not prove equal performance.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t0, least($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()) AS t1
), iv AS (
  SELECT coalesce(i.stage_owner, '(no owner)') AS stage_owner,
         i.gpus,
         i.stage_entered_lower_bound AS lb,
         greatest(i.started_at, w.t0) AS s,
         least(coalesce(i.ended_at, now()), w.t1) AS e,
         CASE WHEN o.objective IS NULL OR i.stage_entered_at IS NULL THEN NULL
              ELSE greatest(i.started_at, i.stage_entered_at + o.objective, w.t0) END AS os,
         r.per_gpu_hour_usd AS rate
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  LEFT JOIN stage_objectives o ON o.stage = i.stage AND o.policy_version = i.policy_version
  LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = i.gpu_model
  LEFT JOIN pricing_rates r ON r.snapshot_id = '${snapshot}' AND r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
  CROSS JOIN w
  WHERE i.category = 'IDLE'
    AND i.started_at < w.t1
    AND coalesce(i.ended_at, now()) > w.t0
    AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
    AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
), owners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(i.stage_owner, '(no owner)') AS stage_owner
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  WHERE i.category = 'IDLE' AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
), agg AS (
  SELECT stage_owner,
         sum(gpus * extract(epoch FROM e - s)) / 3600 AS idle_h,
         sum(gpus * extract(epoch FROM greatest(e - os, interval '0'))) FILTER (WHERE os IS NOT NULL) / 3600 AS overdue_h,
         bool_or(lb) AS any_lb,
         coalesce(sum(gpus * extract(epoch FROM e - s)) FILTER (WHERE os IS NULL), 0) / 3600 AS no_objective_h,
         sum(gpus * extract(epoch FROM e - s) * rate) / 3600 AS idle_usd,
         sum(gpus * extract(epoch FROM greatest(e - os, interval '0')) * rate) FILTER (WHERE os IS NOT NULL) / 3600 AS overdue_usd,
         coalesce(sum(gpus * extract(epoch FROM e - s)) FILTER (WHERE rate IS NULL), 0) / 3600 AS unpriced_h
  FROM iv
  GROUP BY stage_owner
)
SELECT o.stage_owner AS "Stage owner",
       coalesce(g.idle_h, 0) AS "Idle GPU-h",
       CASE WHEN g.stage_owner IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE g.overdue_h END AS "Overdue GPU-h",
       CASE WHEN g.any_lb THEN 'includes waits begun before observation (≥)' ELSE 'fully observed' END AS "Clock",
       coalesce(g.no_objective_h, 0) AS "Idle GPU-h, no objective",
       CASE WHEN g.stage_owner IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE g.idle_usd END AS "Idle value (USD)",
       CASE WHEN g.stage_owner IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE g.overdue_usd END AS "Overdue value (USD)",
       coalesce(g.unpriced_h, 0) AS "Unpriced idle GPU-h"
FROM owners o
LEFT JOIN agg g ON g.stage_owner = o.stage_owner
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id CROSS JOIN w
              WHERE i.started_at < w.t1 AND coalesce(i.ended_at, now()) > w.t0 AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site)))
ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['DC', 'Redbull', 'POPAI', 'Serving'], o.stage_owner), 1

panels.title: Idle and overdue value in the time range (USD): present-day vs historical prices
panels.description:
Definition: the IDLE GPU-hours of 'Idle and overdue GPU-hours in the time range', valued two ways. Present-day: every GPU-hour at the selected snapshot ($snapshot). Historical: each interval at the snapshot of the same region and purchase option that was in force when the interval started (latest publication date at or before its start); importing a newer snapshot never changes it. Overdue = the part after stage_entered_at + objective, as in that table.
Units: USD; GPU-h.
Filters: site, stage_owner, time range, snapshot.
Unknown vs zero: empty value = nothing in that row could be priced. Intervals that started before any snapshot was published are unpriced historically. Unpriced: GPUs whose model is not in the GPU catalogue, has no defensible AWS equivalent, or has no rate in the snapshot are counted in 'Unpriced' and never valued at $0. AWS-equivalent value is a comparison: what the same GPU-hours would cost at AWS On-Demand (Linux, shared tenancy, us-east-1). It is not a bill, not our cost and not a proven loss (AGENT.md §10). Per-GPU rate = whole instance price / physical GPUs, so it includes the host's share and is not a GPU-only tariff; similar GPU names do not prove equal performance.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t0, least($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()) AS t1
), sel AS (
  SELECT provider, region, purchase_option, currency
  FROM pricing_snapshots WHERE snapshot_id = '${snapshot}'
), iv AS (
  SELECT coalesce(i.stage_owner, '(no owner)') AS stage_owner, i.gpus, i.gpu_model, i.started_at,
         greatest(i.started_at, w.t0) AS s,
         least(coalesce(i.ended_at, now()), w.t1) AS e,
         CASE WHEN o.objective IS NULL OR i.stage_entered_at IS NULL THEN NULL
              ELSE greatest(i.started_at, i.stage_entered_at + o.objective, w.t0) END AS os
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  LEFT JOIN stage_objectives o ON o.stage = i.stage AND o.policy_version = i.policy_version
  CROSS JOIN w
  WHERE i.category = 'IDLE'
    AND i.started_at < w.t1
    AND coalesce(i.ended_at, now()) > w.t0
    AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
    AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
), h AS (
  SELECT iv.stage_owner,
         iv.gpus * extract(epoch FROM iv.e - iv.s) / 3600 AS idle_h,
         CASE WHEN iv.os IS NULL THEN NULL
              ELSE iv.gpus * extract(epoch FROM greatest(iv.e - iv.os, interval '0')) / 3600 END AS overdue_h,
         now_r.per_gpu_hour_usd AS now_rate,
         hist_r.per_gpu_hour_usd AS hist_rate,
         hs.snapshot_id AS hist_snapshot
  FROM iv
  LEFT JOIN gpu_model_aliases ga ON ga.raw_model = iv.gpu_model
  LEFT JOIN pricing_rates now_r
         ON now_r.snapshot_id = '${snapshot}' AND now_r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT p.snapshot_id
    FROM pricing_snapshots p
    JOIN sel ON p.provider = sel.provider AND p.region = sel.region
            AND p.purchase_option = sel.purchase_option AND p.currency = sel.currency
    WHERE p.publication_date <= iv.started_at
    ORDER BY p.publication_date DESC, p.captured_at DESC, p.snapshot_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) hs ON true
  LEFT JOIN pricing_rates hist_r
         ON hist_r.snapshot_id = hs.snapshot_id AND hist_r.gpu_model = ga.canonical
)
SELECT stage_owner AS "Stage owner",
       sum(idle_h) AS "Idle GPU-h",
       sum(idle_h * now_rate) AS "Idle USD, present-day",
       sum(idle_h * hist_rate) AS "Idle USD, historical",
       sum(overdue_h * now_rate) AS "Overdue USD, present-day",
       sum(overdue_h * hist_rate) AS "Overdue USD, historical",
       coalesce(sum(idle_h) FILTER (WHERE now_rate IS NULL), 0) AS "Unpriced GPU-h, present-day",
       coalesce(sum(idle_h) FILTER (WHERE hist_rate IS NULL), 0) AS "Unpriced GPU-h, historical",
       coalesce((SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT to_char(p.publication_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ', ')
                 FROM pricing_snapshots p WHERE p.snapshot_id = ANY (array_agg(h.hist_snapshot))), 'none in force') AS "Historical price dates"
FROM h
GROUP BY stage_owner
ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['DC', 'Redbull', 'POPAI', 'Serving'], stage_owner), 1

panels.title: Overdue GPUs over time, by stage owner
panels.description:
Definition: idle GPUs past their stage objective at each point in the time range, sampled from the ledger, one line per stage owner. Rising = a queue falling further behind. The chart starts at the first engine scan.
Filters: site, stage_owner, time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT generate_series($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, least($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()),
                         make_interval(secs => greatest($__interval_ms, 300000) / 1000.0)) AS t
), iv AS (
  SELECT t.t, i.stage_owner, i.gpus,
         (o.objective IS NOT NULL AND t.t > i.stage_entered_at + o.objective) AS overdue
  FROM t
  JOIN capacity_intervals i ON i.category = 'IDLE' AND i.started_at <= t.t AND (i.ended_at IS NULL OR i.ended_at > t.t)
  JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  LEFT JOIN stage_objectives o ON o.stage = i.stage AND o.policy_version = i.policy_version
  WHERE ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site)) AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
)
SELECT t.t AS time,
       coalesce(sum(iv.gpus) FILTER (WHERE iv.stage_owner = 'DC' AND iv.overdue), 0) AS "DC",
       coalesce(sum(iv.gpus) FILTER (WHERE iv.stage_owner = 'Redbull' AND iv.overdue), 0) AS "Redbull",
       coalesce(sum(iv.gpus) FILTER (WHERE iv.stage_owner = 'POPAI' AND iv.overdue), 0) AS "POPAI",
       coalesce(sum(iv.gpus) FILTER (WHERE iv.stage_owner = 'Serving' AND iv.overdue), 0) AS "Serving"
FROM t
LEFT JOIN iv ON iv.t = t.t
WHERE t.t >= (SELECT min(started_at) FROM scan_runs WHERE status IN ('ok', 'partial'))
GROUP BY t.t
ORDER BY t.t
